title: Supported countries
description: The catalogue is the supported subset of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries needed by BU-DO-KON, not the complete ISO set. It may include currently unreferenced entries. Inactive entries are retained for historical compatibility and display, but canonical judoka must reference an existing active entry.

additionalProperties.description: The embedded code must equal the object key; the build performs this cross-property validation.
